subject: martina
input_roles: official costume and hair material reference only
prompt:
Precise local edit of Image 1, the existing 12-frame 4 by 3 Martina sprite sheet. Image 2 is costume material reference only. Preserve the same sheet dimensions, every pose and expression, two-head ratio, silhouette, body and foot position, camera position/angle/lens direction and blue/orange effects, empty transparent gutters. The visible brown/blue haze is hidden RGB under transparent alpha, not an intended background. Preserve actual transparency. NO redesign or motion changes.

Change ONLY INTERNAL PIXEL DETAILS in the current hair and costume, a modest upgrade with substantially crisper pixel craft:
- Keep gray-brown hair color, size, silhouette and exact cream-colored front streak. Add discrete 4–6px square/stair-step HIGHLIGHT CLUSTERS and darker shadow CLUSTERS inside the existing locks to separate their planes. Use 4 or 5 solid colors. NO blended gradients, soft texture, thin painted strands, dithering or antialiasing.
- Keep mustard coat, vest, belt, pouches, ripped teal jeans and boots exactly the current shapes. Add compact 3–5px square honey-gold highlight planes and ochre/brown shadow folds on existing coat lapels, shoulders, sleeve and tails. Make existing seams/cuff/belt/buckle highlights clearer in stepped square clusters; add a few denim fold and boot leather reflections. Do not change the jean tears or accessories.
- Face, eye/eyepatch and facial expressions are untouched. The opaque black eyepatch with tiny cross decoration must stay opaque; do not make glasses/monocle. Keep camcorder and effects unchanged; its black/red lens stays on the viewer-left end.
Visible main pixel size, black outline, two-head style and all motions remain the approved image 1 style. No smoothing or painterly rendering. No new effects, garments, accessories, text, grids, cell borders or background. Genuine transparency. Every frame stays entirely in the same separate cell.
